For Respondent(s) : Mr. Mukesh Trivedi, PP  Mr. Nikhil Bhandari, for respondent
MR. JUSTICE MANOJ KUMAR GARG Order 21/04/2023

The instant criminal misc. petition under Section 482 Cr.P.c. has been filed by the petitioner against the order dated 03.12.2022 passed by the learned Judicial Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate Gudamalani, District Barmer, in Criminal Original Case No.73/2019 whereby the learned trial Court has allowed the compromise for offence under Sections 420 and 408 IPC and declined to compound the offence under Sections 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC on the basis of compromise between the parties.

entities.text: Judicial Addl. Chief Judicial Magistrate Gudamalani, District Barmer
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Counsel for the petitioners submits that the matter has already been compromised between the parties and it is borne out from the compromise that respondent No.2 is not inclined to [2023/RJJD/011400] (2 of 2) [CRLMP-667/2023] proceed further in the matter.

Counsel has placed reliance on a decision of Supreme Court in the case of Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab & Anr.
[(2012) 10 SCC 303].

entities.text: Suresh Kumar vs State Of Rajasthan (2023/Rjjd/011400)

sentences.text: Counsel for the respondent concurs the fact of compromise and submits that in view of the compromise, the respondent No.2 does not want to proceed further in the matter.

In view of compromise arrived at between the parties and applying the ratio in decision of Gian Singh (Supra), I deem it just and proper to invoke inherent powers of this Court under Section 482 Cr.P.C.
Accordingly, the present misc. petition is allowed and the order dated 03.12.2022 passed by the court below is quashed to the extent of declining to compound the offence under Sections 467, 468,
471 and 120-B of IPC and the offence under Sections 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of IPC is hereby compounded on the basis of compromise deed and the entire criminal proceedings pursuant to Criminal Original Case No.73/2019 and subsequent proceedings are also quashed and set aside on the basis of compromise arrived at between the parties.
(MANOJ KUMAR GARG),J 75-Ishan/-
